title: cli: os dev reports a config-load refusal (for example a licence or KMS refusal) as "Compile failed — fix errors above"
body:
Filing category: ① product defect (operator-visible message).
reach: public entry `os dev` (via `pnpm dev` in cloud `apps/objectos-ee`), measured once (cloud `ff373e02`, framework `d7c3d44e`).
Batch-of: 15 cards filed together from one MCP capability test session (2026-11-11; 6 in cloud, 9 in objectstack).

## Business reason

An operator whose deployment refuses to start for a configuration reason reads "Compile failed" and goes looking for a code error.

## Steps

`OS_CRYPTO_PROVIDER=aws-kms` set, no usable licence (the licence was in a variable the runtime does not read), `pnpm dev -- --fresh -p 38611` in `apps/objectos-ee`.

## What happens

```
◆ Compile
  → Loading configuration...
  ObjectOS Community mode — NO valid Enterprise license …
  ✖ [kms] OS_CRYPTO_PROVIDER=aws-kms asks for customer-managed keys, which require an Enterprise licence that enables `customerManagedKeys`. Refusing to boot …
  ✗ Compile failed — fix errors above before starting dev server
```

The refusal is thrown while loading `objectstack.config.ts`; `packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts` labels any failure in that phase as a compile failure.

## Expected

A refusal raised while loading the config is reported as a refused boot / configuration error with its own text, not as a compile failure.

Reader who acts: the seat that owns `packages/cli` (`dev` command).
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue Compile failed config load` → 1068 hits (broad term); top 3 (#31264, #31112, #31968) unrelated; none on this label.
